de: Raid on Żejtun: The south east of Malta, and the town of Żejtun, suffer a raid from Ottoman forces. This was the last unsuccessful attempt by the Ottomans to conquer the island of Malta.

dz: 英格兰女王玛丽一世的王后西班牙国王腓力二世从多佛出发与法国开战,最终导致加来城被丧失,而加来城是该大陆上最后的英国占有地,玛丽一世再也没有见到她的丈夫.
de: King Philip II of Spain, consort of Queen Mary I of England, sets out from Dover to war with France, which eventually resulted in the loss of the city of Calais, the last English possession on the continent, and Mary I never seeing her husband again.

dz: 托马斯·莫尔在被伪证定罪后被处决.

de: The explorer Jacques Cartier lands at St. Malo at the end of his second expedition to North America. He returns with none of the gold he expected to find.
